name: exec_command
args:
{"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, shutil, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path('data/orders')
backup=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='orders-original-', dir='/tmp'))
for f in root.rglob('*.json'):
    dest=backup / f.relative_to(root)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(f, dest)
    text=f.read_text()
    order=json.loads(text)
    if order['status']=='paid':
        assert text.endswith('\n}\n')
        count=sum(item['qty'] for item in order['items'])
        f.write_text(text[:-3] + ',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(count) + '\n}\n')
print('Backup:', backup)
PY"}

name: exec_command
args:
{"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('data/orders'); backup=pathlib.Path('/tmp/orders-original-auw0bcf4')
paid=other=0
for f in root.rglob('*.json'):
    old=(backup/f.relative_to(root)).read_text(); new=f.read_text()
    before=json.loads(old); after=json.loads(new)
    if before['status']=='paid':
        count=sum(item['qty'] for item in before['items'])
        assert after == {**before, 'itemCount': count}, f
        assert new == old[:-3] + ',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(count) + '\n}\n', f
        assert new == json.dumps(after, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', f
        paid+=1
    else:
        assert new==old, f
        other+=1
print(f'Verified {paid} paid orders and {other} unchanged non-paid orders.')
PY
